title: hq stats: filter by goal or time, export CSV
acceptance: `hq stats --goal <name>` (repeatable) keeps only the tasks of those goals, and only the goal-level events (report shown, approve, merge, escalate) of those goals

`hq stats --since <date> --until <date>` (ISO 8601 date or date-time, either bound optional, since inclusive, until exclusive) keeps only the tasks started in that window, all events of those tasks, and the goal-level events of their goals; a date that does not parse is refused with a non-zero exit

Filters combine with each other and with every output: the default table, --json, --tasks and the new --csv; the default table's heading names the filters applied, and the metrics are computed over the filtered tasks only, with their denominators

`hq stats --csv` prints a header and one row per task: task, goal, title, difficulty, model, status, started_at, merged_at, lines, cost_usd, the pass and fail counts of each gate, escaped; fields are quoted per RFC 4180 so commas, quotes and newlines in titles survive
When no task matches, the table says so and --csv prints only the header; exit 0
Tests in hq/test with a temporary HQ_HOME cover each filter, their combination, the date refusal, CSV quoting, and the no-match case
